description: The first plot in Figure 4.1 illustrates the Word Error Rate (WER) during the fine-tuning of the Whisper model with varying amounts of weights. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," ranges from 0 to 6, indicating the number of epochs during the training process. The y-axis, labeled "WER," ranges from 10 to 70, representing the Word Error Rate percentage. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different model configuration: tiny, base, small, medium, and large. The tiny model, represented by a blue line with circle markers, shows a decreasing trend in WER as the number of epochs increases, starting at around 70 and ending near 20. The base model, depicted by a blue line with square markers, also shows a decreasing trend, starting at around 60 and ending near 30. The small model, represented by an orange line with triangle markers, shows a fluctuating trend, starting at around 40 and ending near 25. The medium model, depicted by a green line with diamond markers, shows a decreasing trend, starting at around 50 and ending near 20. The large model, represented by a purple line with star markers, shows a fluctuating trend, starting at around 30 and ending near 15.
